card.name: Change and movement verbs in clinical text
card.fires_on: Words about changing or moving, such as modified, migrate, migration and entry, in drug-label sentences. It also fires on a few word endings like the s in EMs or the us in skeletal-muscle.

modes.label: Change or movement words
modes.description: Verbs and nouns for something being adjusted or travelling, like modified, migrate, migration or entry.
modes.example: oxygen and ventilatory support can be<< modified>> in response to changes in respiratory status.

modes.label: Partway through a word
modes.description: A short piece inside or at the end of a medical term, such as the plural s on EM or the us in muscle.
modes.example: EM<<s>> Taking a strong or moderate CYP2

modes.label: Needle size word
modes.description: The word gauge after a number when describing needles.
modes.example: Using syringe with 19 to 22<< gauge>> needle, puncture resealable
